name: drm-wrap-monorepo
description: DRM-Wrap: npm CLI + secure Electron desktop app generator with anti-screen-capture and DRM features

scripts.postinstall: node node_modules/electron/install.js && (xattr -cr node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null || true) && (codesign --force --deep --sign - node_modules/electron/dist/Electron.app 2>/dev/null || true)

author: vecvel
